mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_account (user_id) VALUES (#{userId}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE wallet_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}::numeric, total_recharge = total_recharge + CASE WHEN #{kind} = 'RECHARGE' THEN #{amount}::numeric ELSE 0 END, total_earned = total_earned + CASE WHEN #{kind} IN ('EARN','REFUND') THEN #{amount}::numeric ELSE 0 END, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 RETURNING balance

UPDATE wallet_account SET balance = balance - #{amount}::numeric, total_spent = total_spent + #{amount}::numeric, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND balance >= #{amount}::numeric RETURNING balance
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_account SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_transaction (user_id, type, amount, balance_after, channel, title, ref_type, ref_id, remark, operator_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{remark}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select:
SELECT count(*) FROM wallet_account w JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = w.user_id
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.phone ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

SELECT count(*) AS "accounts", COALESCE(sum(balance), 0) AS "balance", COALESCE(sum(total_recharge), 0) AS "recharge", COALESCE(sum(total_spent), 0) AS "spent", COALESCE(sum(total_earned), 0) AS "earned", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 0) AS "frozen", COALESCE((SELECT sum(amount) FROM wallet_transaction WHERE type = 'RECHARGE' AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())), 0) AS "todayRecharge", COALESCE((SELECT sum(-amount) FROM wallet_transaction WHERE type = 'CONSUME' AND created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())), 0) AS "todayConsume", (SELECT count(*) FROM recharge_order WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS "pendingOrders", (SELECT COALESCE(sum(commission), 0) FROM proxy_order WHERE status = 'DONE') AS "commission" FROM wallet_account

SELECT to_char(d.day, 'MM-DD') AS "day", COALESCE(r.amt, 0) AS "recharge", COALESCE(c.amt, 0) AS "consume", COALESCE(e.amt, 0) AS "earn" FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', now()) - (#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day', date_trunc('day', now()), interval '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN (SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, sum(amount) AS amt FROM wallet_transaction WHERE type = 'RECHARGE' GROUP BY 1) r ON r.day = d.day LEFT JOIN (SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, sum(-amount) AS amt FROM wallet_transaction WHERE type = 'CONSUME' GROUP BY 1) c ON c.day = d.day LEFT JOIN (SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, sum(amount) AS amt FROM wallet_transaction WHERE type IN ('EARN','REFUND') GROUP BY 1) e ON e.day = d.day ORDER BY d.day
SELECT type AS "name", count(*) AS "value", COALESCE(sum(abs(amount)), 0) AS "amount" FROM wallet_transaction GROUP BY type ORDER BY "value" DESC
